notes: 📎 L.R. copy on every saved invoice: upload a photo or PDF, drag it in, or paste a picture (Ctrl+V). Photos are made smaller and saved in the invoice folder next to the invoice PDF; the L.R. copy is ticked in the invoice email and can be emailed from the L.R. box. Settings → Universal rules: switch automatic invoice email on or off. Email templates: a sales template can be set to Send automatically or by hand only.
